aboutUs:
Anglia Ruskin University - ARU is one of the top 350 universities in the world (Times Higher Education World University Rankings) and is an innovative institution which is also considered a ‘rising star’ – one of the institutions predicted to be challenging the global elite by 2030.
Many courses are recognised by industry, and a large number are professionally accredited. Businesses regularly come back to us for interns, training, research and collaborative programmes. With 84% overall satisfaction in the National Student Survey 2018, our students are some of the most satisfied in the country. We’re one of the largest universities in the East of England and have two main campuses in Chelmsford and Cambridge, each less than an hour away from London. Both cities have been rated in the top ten best places to live in the UK. So come and join our international community of over 100 nationalities and make your ambitions a reality.

aboutUs:
Aston University is a campus-based institution located in the heart of Birmingham, the UK’s second-largest city. Established in 1895, Aston received its Royal Charter in 1966 from Queen Elizabeth II, officially becoming a university. Today, Aston is known for its focus on employability and research, consistently maintaining a strong presence in both national and international rankings.
The University’s campus is home to five schools: Aston Business School, the College of Engineering and Physical Sciences, the College of Health and Life Sciences, the College of Business and Social Sciences, and the Aston Medical School. It offers a wide range of programmes, including foundation courses, undergraduate, postgraduate taught, and research degrees. Aston has a diverse student community, with over 11,000 undergraduates and more than 2,000 postgraduate students from over 120 countries.
The University offers over 30 Joint Honours degrees, allowing students to study two subjects at Honours level, integrating both academic areas seamlessly. In addition to its degree programmes, Aston provides opportunities for students to learn a new language or improve existing language skills. Options include French, German, Spanish, Mandarin, and Arabic, available either as part of a degree programme or as an extracurricular activity. The University’s emphasis on providing real-world experience is highlighted by its pioneering placement year programme, which offers students invaluable industry experience before graduation.
Aston's campus is ideally situated just a 10-minute walk from Birmingham’s main shopping and entertainment centres, providing students with easy access to the city’s vibrant cultural scene. Birmingham was ranked highest for quality of life outside London in the Mercer Quality of Living Report, and Aston has also been recognised as one of the friendliest universities in the UK, enhancing its appeal as a student-friendly destination.

aboutUs:
24,000 students from over 80 countries are enrolled at Birmingham City University, making it an exciting and diverse place to study. A significant proportion of undergraduate courses enjoy professional accreditation, including Accountancy, Acting, Architecture, Education, Engineering, Law, Marketing, Nursing, Radiography and Social Work. The university is also conveniently placed, with Birmingham International Airport nearby and easy road and rail links to London, Manchester and the rest of the UK.
Birmingham City University has a large number of part-time students enrolled, making it the largest provider of undergraduate study in the area. In addition, the University has increased its portfolio of high-tech degrees in recent years, with a particular focus on electronic commerce, network engineering and electronic systems.
Birmingham City University is one of the top 30 universities in the UK for spending on facilities, and in the most recent National Student Survey, 84% of students were happy with their course, while 87% agreed that faculty staff were good at explaining classes and teaching.

aboutUs:
Brunel University London is a campus university located in Uxbridge, north-west London. It is within walking distance of the London Underground, just a 40-minute ride into the city and 20 minutes away from Heathrow Airport. It is one of the UK’s most ambitious, forward-looking universities and home to just under 18,000 students from over 150 countries.
Brunel is in the top quarter of universities in the world and ranked 38th in the UK (QS World University Rankings 2025) with 95% of courses offering a one-year placement year and over 100 taught master's degrees, enabling students to become experts in their chosen field.
Brunel guarantees accommodation on campus for the duration of studies (T&Cs apply).  They are also ranked joint 1st in the UK and 4th in the world for ‘international outlook’ by the Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2024. Expanding horizons and gaining new perspectives through Brunel’s international community.
